title: Atmus Filtration Technologies Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (Atmus; NYSE: ATMU), a global leader in filtration and media solutions, today reported financial results for its fourth quarter and full year that ended December 31, 2025. Fourth Quarter and Full Year Highlights Net sales of $447 million for the fourth quarter and $1,764 million for the full year GAAP net income of $48 million for the fourth quarter and $207 million for the full year Diluted earnings per share of $0.58 for the fourth quarter and $2.50 for the full year Adjusted earnings per share of $0.66 for the fourth quarter and $2.73 for the full year Adjusted EBITDA of $85 million and Adjusted EBITDA margin of 19.1% for the fourth quarter Adjusted EBITDA of $354 million and Adjusted EBITDA margin of 20.0% for the full year Cash provided by operating activities was $48 million for the fourth quarter and $203 million for the full year Adjusted free cash flow was $31 million for the fourth quarter and $158 million for the full year Atmus completed
